name: Death and the Grave
sub: From the last breath to the Trumpet

events.title: The soul is taken
events.summary: The angel of death, put in charge of you, takes the soul.

steps.title: The angel of death arrives
steps.summary: The angel of death, charged with each soul, comes to take it.

steps.title: Taken in peace
steps.summary: The angels take the soul of the pure and say: peace be upon you, enter Paradise for what you used to do.

steps.title: Souls forced out
steps.summary: The wrongdoers are in the anguish of death while the angels stretch out their hands: discharge your souls, today you are repaid with a punishment of humiliation.

events.title: The three questions
events.summary: Who is your Lord? What is your religion? Who is this man sent to you?

steps.title: Made to sit up
steps.summary: Two angels come to the dead person and make him sit up to question him.

steps.title: Believer answers surely
steps.summary: He says: my Lord is Allah, my religion is Islam, he is the Messenger of Allah. A caller from heaven declares him truthful and opens a door to Paradise for him.

steps.title: Disbeliever falters
steps.summary: He can only say: alas, I do not know. A caller declares him a liar and opens a door to the Fire for him.

events.title: Munkar and Nakir
events.summary: The two angels who question the dead are named.

steps.title: Munkar and Nakir arrive
steps.summary: Two black, blue-eyed angels come and ask: what did you used to say about this man?

steps.title: Grave widened for the believer
steps.summary: His grave is opened out seventy by seventy cubits and lit up, and he is told to sleep like a bridegroom.

steps.title: Earth closes on him
steps.summary: The hypocrite can only say he does not know; the earth is told to close on him until his ribs are crushed together.

events.title: Barzakh
events.summary: A barrier behind them until the Day they are raised.

steps.title: Pleads to be sent back
steps.summary: The dying wrongdoer begs: my Lord, send me back, that I might do good in what I left behind.

steps.title: The barrier is set
steps.summary: No, it is only a word he speaks. Behind them is a barrier until the Day they are raised.

events.title: A garden or a pit
events.summary: The grave is shown their seat morning and evening.

steps.title: Shown his place
steps.summary: Each person is shown their place, in Paradise or in the Fire, morning and evening.

steps.title: A garden
steps.summary: If he is one of the people of Paradise, he is shown his place there.

steps.title: A pit of the Fire
steps.summary: If he is one of the people of the Fire, he is shown his place there, as the Family of Fir'awn are shown the Fire morning and evening.
